# Conditions

Conditions go after `if`, `else if` and `while`, or on a line of their own. 27 entries. Search all of them on the [reference home](./index.md).

In a pattern, `%type%` is a value, `[...]` is optional and `(a|b)` means one of the words.

## And / or {#and_or}

```carve
%condition% and %condition%
%condition% or %condition%
%condition%, %condition% and %condition%
```

Joins conditions. Brackets group them.

```carve
if player is sneaking and player is on the ground:
    send "crouched" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [conditions](../syntax/conditions.md)

## Block is type {#block_is}

```carve
%block% is [not] %item% [or %item%]
```

Checks a block's type. False when the block cannot be read.

```carve
if block below player is grass block or dirt:
    send "soft ground" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [blocks](../syntax/blocks.md)

## Can fly {#can_fly}

```carve
%player% can fly
%player% (can't|cannot|can not) fly
```

Whether the player may fly. Follows the game mode (creative and spectator).

```carve
if player can fly:
    send "you can fly" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [player-flags](../syntax/player-flags.md)

## Chance {#chance}

```carve
chance of %number%%
```

True with that percent chance.

```carve
if chance of 10%:
    give diamond to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [conditions](../syntax/conditions.md)

## Compare numbers {#compare}

```carve
%number% > %number%
%number% < %number%
%number% >= %number%
%number% <= %number%
```

Compares numbers, timespans or dates.

```carve
if health of player < 6:
    send "Careful!" to player
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [conditions](../syntax/conditions.md)

## Ends with {#ends_with}

```carve
%text% ends with %text%
%text% (does not|doesn't) end with %text%
```

Whether a text ends with another. Case is ignored.

```carve
on chat:
    if message ends with "?":
        send "good question" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [conditions](../syntax/conditions.md)

## Has item {#has_item}

```carve
%player% has %item%
%player% (does not|doesn't) have %item%
```

Whether the player has at least that many of an item.

```carve
if player has 3 diamonds:
    send "rich" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [conditions](../syntax/conditions.md)

## Has permission {#permission}

```carve
%player% has permission %text%
%player% does not have permission %text%
```

Checks a permission node.

```carve
if player has permission "vip":
    send "Hi VIP" to player
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [conditions](../syntax/conditions.md)

## Has potion effect {#potion}

```carve
%player% has potion effect <effect>
%player% (does not|doesn't) have potion effect <effect>
```

Whether the player has a potion effect.

```carve

    send "zoom" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [world-effects](../syntax/world-effects.md)

## Inventory contains {#inventory_contains}

```carve
%player%'s inventory contains %item%
inventory of %player% contains %item%
%player%'s inventory does not contain %item%
```

Whether the player's inventory holds the item.

```carve
if player's inventory contains 2 diamonds:
    send "ok" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [inventories](../syntax/inventories.md)

## Is a player {#is_player}

```carve
%object% is (a|an) player
%object% (is not|isn't) (a|an) player
```

Whether a value, usually `sender`, is a player.

```carve
if sender is a player:
    send "hi" to sender
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [senders](../syntax/senders.md)

## Is banned {#banned}

```carve
%object% is banned
%object% (is not|isn't) banned
```

Parses, but is always false for now: Pumpkin gives plugins no way to read the ban list.

```carve
if "Alex" is banned:
    send "banned"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [op-kick-ban](../syntax/op-kick-ban.md)

## Is between {#between}

```carve
%number% is between %number% and %number%
%number% is not between %number% and %number%
```

Whether a number is in a range, both ends included.

```carve
if level of player is between 10 and 20:
    send "mid level" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [conditions](../syntax/conditions.md)

## Is blocking {#blocking}

```carve
%player% is blocking
%player% (is not|isn't) blocking
```

Always false for now: the plugin API has no shield state.

```carve
if player is blocking:
    send "blocked" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [player-flags](../syntax/player-flags.md)

## Is equal {#equal}

```carve
%object% (is|=) %object%
%object% (is not|!=) %object%
```

Compares two values. Text compares without case; `x is a or b` checks several options.

```carve
command /toggle <text>:
    trigger:
        if arg is "on" or "yes":
            send "enabled"
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [conditions](../syntax/conditions.md)

## Is flying {#flying}

```carve
%player% is flying
%player% (is not|isn't) flying
```

Whether the player is flying, tracked from flight toggle events.

```carve

    send "up there" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [player-flags](../syntax/player-flags.md)

## Is op {#op}


## Is set {#is_set}

```carve
%object% is set
%object% is not set
```

Whether a variable or value has a value. A list is set when it has at least one item.

```carve

    send "No home yet" to player
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [conditions](../syntax/conditions.md)

## Starts with {#starts_with}

```carve
%text% starts with %text%

```

Whether a text starts with another. Case is ignored.

## Text or list contains {#contains}

```carve
%text% contains %text%
%text% (does not|doesn't) contain %text%
%list% contains %object%
```

Whether a text has a piece in it, or a list has an item. Case is ignored.

```carve
on chat:
    if message contains "hello":
        send "hi!" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [conditions](../syntax/conditions.md)
